name: Homiez Preroll 28pk | Purple Lemon Punch Strawz
description:
Pre-rolls are the ultimate plug-and-play option. No grinding, no packing, no rolling skills required — just spark and vibe. Each pre-roll comes expertly packed with quality ground flower, wrapped tight with a sturdy filter so every pull hits smooth and easy. Whether you’re cracking one solo or passing a few around, this 28-pack keeps the good times flowing.
HOMIEZ is all about good smoke, good people, and good prices. Our mid-range flower is built for everyday seshes — perfect for kicking it with the crew, winding down, or turning up the moment. With a strain lineup that stays stacked and surprises every time, there’s a vibe in here for everyone. Comfortable, satisfying, and always homie-approved. ????
SATIVA 
FLAVORS :
Berry, Citrus, Fruity, Orange, Sour, Sugary, Sweet
